data.name: Magnus
data.gender_notes: Magnus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word magnus, meaning ‘great’ or ‘powerful’. The name Magnus was borne by several early Christian saints, including St. Magnus of Orkney and St. Magnus of Sens. The name Magnus carries the meaning “Great in power” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Magnus usually hope their child will grow to embody great in power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength and power in one's spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Magnus belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Great in power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Magnus total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: מגנוס
in_hebrew.meaning: גדול וחזק, שמו של שם נרדף למשמעות גדולה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם מגנוס מקורו בלטינית, אך משמעותו קשורה לשם העברי גדול, שפירושו חזק וגדול. במסגרת השפה העברית, השם מגנוס מתורגם כגדול וחזק, ומשויך לתכונות של כוח ואצילות.

in_greek.name: Μάγνος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Μάγνος στην ελληνική γλώσσα προέρχεται από τη λατινική λέξη 'magnus', που σημαίνει μεγάλος. Στην ελληνική χριστιανική παράδοση, το όνομα Μάγνος θεωρείται σύμβολο δύναμης και ανδρείας, ενώ συνδέεται και με την έννοια του μεγάλου και ισχυρού.

in_latin.name: Magnus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Magnus originates from Latin, meaning 'great' or 'powerful'. In the early Christian Church, the name Magnus was bestowed upon individuals of remarkable strength, courage, or stature. Throughout Christian tradition, Magnus signifies greatness, fortitude, and spiritual magnitude.

in_english.name: Magnus
in_english.long_meaning: The name Magnus originates from Latin roots, signifying 'great' or 'mighty'. It has been adopted into various Christian cultures, symbolizing strength, courage, and grandeur. Historically, Magnus has been associated with saintly figures and notable leaders, embodying qualities of leadership and spiritual fortitude.

data.cultural_impact: The name Magnus has long been associated with strength, power, and nobility in European culture. Years ago, European men named their sons Magnus as a sign of their hope for their offspring to embody these virtues. Nowadays, the name is still recognized for its regal connotation and educational achievement.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Magnus holds deep spiritual significance. The name is associated with St. Magnus, a nobleman who lived during the 12th century. After hearing the call of God, he left his luxurious life and committed himself to the Christian faith. St. Magnus's life story serves as a reminder of the Christian virtues of humility, selflessness, and faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Magnus, meaning "great" or "mighty" in Latin, symbolizes the belief in the inherent greatness and power of God within each believer. It is a reminder of the strength and courage that comes from faith.

historical_references.reference: In Norse mythology, Magnus was the name of several gods, most notably Magnus the Good or Magnus the Mighty. He was the god of fertility, protection, and the sea. His name derives from the Old Norse magan, meaning 'might, power, strength'.

Saint Magnus Ericson was a legendary Norse-Icelandic chieftain who, according to Icelandic sagas, led a group of settlers to Iceland in the late 9th century CE. The name Magnus is believed to derive from Old Norse magan, meaning 'might, power, strength'.

modern_usage.modern_context: The Christian name 'Magnus' has gained popularity in various modern contexts, primarily within the realms of Nordic mythology, fantasy literature, and role-playing games. It is often associated with strength, power, and nobility. In online communities like Reddit, there are various groups dedicated to discussing the mythology and history surrounding the name. In Live-Action Role-Playing (LARP) groups, Magnus is a common name for powerful characters. In pen-and-paper role-playing sessions, it's not uncommon for players to create a character named Magnus. The name has also found its way into fantasy literature, with many authors using it for their strong and noble characters.

name_in_real_life.story: Thomas Magnus from New York, United States embodies the meaning of Magnus - "Great in power". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
